    OR sbticker.sbtickersymbol LIKE '%GOOGL%'

WITH _s2 AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS agg_1,
    CONCAT_WS(
      '-',
      CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', start_dt) AS INTEGER),
      CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', start_dt) AS INTEGER)) >= 2
        THEN SUBSTRING(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', start_dt) AS INTEGER), 1, 2)
        ELSE SUBSTRING('00' || CAST(STRFTIME('%m', start_dt) AS INTEGER), (
          2 * -1
        ))
      END
    ) AS treatment_month
  FROM main.treatments
  WHERE
    (
      (
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', start_dt) AS INTEGER)
      ) * 12 + CAST(STRFTIME('%m', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%m', start_dt) AS INTEGER)
    ) <= 3
    AND (
      (
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', start_dt) AS INTEGER)
      ) * 12 + CAST(STRFTIME('%m', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%m', start_dt) AS INTEGER)
    ) >= 1
  GROUP BY
    CONCAT_WS(
      '-',
      CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', start_dt) AS INTEGER),
      CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', start_dt) AS INTEGER)) >= 2
        THEN SUBSTRING(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', start_dt) AS INTEGER), 1, 2)
        ELSE SUBSTRING('00' || CAST(STRFTIME('%m', start_dt) AS INTEGER), (
          2 * -1
        ))
      END
    )
), _s3 AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT treatments.patient_id) AS agg_0,
    CONCAT_WS(
      '-',
      CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER),
      CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER)) >= 2
        THEN SUBSTRING(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER), 1, 2)
        ELSE SUBSTRING('00' || CAST(STRFTIME('%m', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER), (
          2 * -1
        ))
      END
    ) AS treatment_month
  FROM main.treatments AS treatments
  LEFT JOIN main.drugs AS drugs
    ON drugs.drug_id = treatments.drug_id
  WHERE
    (
      (
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER)
      ) * 12 + CAST(STRFTIME('%m', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%m', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER)
    ) <= 3
    AND (
      (
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER)
      ) * 12 + CAST(STRFTIME('%m', DATETIME('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%m', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER)
    ) >= 1
    AND IIF(LOWER(drugs.drug_type) = 'biologic', 1, 0) = 1
  GROUP BY
    CONCAT_WS(
      '-',
      CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER),
      CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER)) >= 2
        THEN SUBSTRING(CAST(STRFTIME('%m', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER), 1, 2)
        ELSE SUBSTRING('00' || CAST(STRFTIME('%m', treatments.start_dt) AS INTEGER), (
          2 * -1
        ))
      END
    )
)
SELECT
  _s2.treatment_month AS month,
  COALESCE(_s2.agg_1, 0) AS patient_count,
  COALESCE(_s3.agg_0, 0) AS biologic_treatment_count
FROM _s2 AS _s2
LEFT JOIN _s3 AS _s3
  ON _s2.treatment_month = _s3.treatment_month
ORDER BY
  month DESC

  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT coupon_id) AS agg_0,
    COUNT(DISTINCT txid) AS agg_1,

    LOWER(status) = 'success'

).ORDER_BY(week_start.DESC())

WITH _s1 AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT() AS agg_0,
    SUM(amount) AS agg_1,
    coupon_id
  FROM main.wallet_transactions_daily
  GROUP BY
    coupon_id
)
SELECT
  coupons.code AS coupon_code,
  COALESCE(_s1.agg_0, 0) AS total_redemptions,
  COALESCE(_s1.agg_1, 0) AS total_amount_redeemed
FROM main.coupons AS coupons
LEFT JOIN _s1 AS _s1
  ON _s1.coupon_id = coupons.cid
WHERE
  (
    NOT _s1.agg_0 IS NULL AND _s1.agg_0 > 0
  ) = 1
ORDER BY
  total_redemptions DESC
LIMIT 3
